title: I Noticed Another Pattern in 'Mallworld'
content: There are some threads here that I posted about 'mallworld' being a kind of purgatory, and the 'floor' we go to depends on our state of mind at the time Yesterday I did a 'test' and it gave results that scared me a lot. I decided to watch a horror film and then a pornographic one before going to sleep, the dream I had was very spiritual with the same 'mallworld', the second one I dream about the most, a square in my city, but with more stores, with a lot of movement, and There is something I had noticed before but never put into the theory of purgatory: People are all sinners. (Before that, when walking to this square, I saw 3 cars passing by with images of Our Lady, and they were falling from the cars) But back to people, this is a very important aspect that is present in all the mallworld dreams I have, I see a lot of trashy people, sluts, drug addicts, people who you see are not criminals or satanic, but are immersed in sin. That night, they were ordinary people I'd never met, but they were there, some childhood friends too. Has anyone else noticed this pattern of sinful people on Mallworld? I don't think this is 'proof' of purgatory, but it is something very curious. (A Praça da cidade na foto)
